# QR Code Create

QR Code Create is a free QR code generator in Japanese. No registration is required and there are no ads. It supports UTM parameters so you can measure access separately for each printed material. The site URL is https://qr-create.jp

## Overview
QR Code Create is a free QR code generator with UTM parameter guidance. The service is provided in Japanese at https://qr-create.jp

## Features
- QR code generation (instant from URL input)
- UTM parameter setup guidance (step-by-step)
- UTM presets for flyer, poster, business card, brochure, banner, receipt, product package, menu, signage
- Decorative frame presets (5 types: Simple, Business, Casual, Elegant, Pop)
- Logo embedding
- Color customization (foreground/background)
- Caption text
- PNG/SVG/PDF export

## Target Users
Japanese small business owners, event organizers, marketers

## Key Differentiator
- Free, no registration required
- UTM parameter guidance to prevent forgetting tracking parameters
- Decorative frames to customize QR code appearance
- Marketing education content included

## Language
Japanese (ja). All pages are written in Japanese.

## Pages
- https://qr-create.jp/ : Top page
- https://qr-create.jp/create : QR code generator (the tool itself)
- https://qr-create.jp/guide : Guide index
- https://qr-create.jp/guide/getting-started : Getting started: create a QR code in 3 steps
- https://qr-create.jp/guide/utm-parameters : What UTM parameters are
- https://qr-create.jp/guide/utm-setup : How to set UTM parameters in the tool
- https://qr-create.jp/use-cases : QR codes by use case (flyer, poster, business card, menu, signage, receipt, product package, store, event)
- https://qr-create.jp/faq : FAQ
- https://qr-create.jp/blog : Blog

## URL
https://qr-create.jp
